intent: Create a 16:9 horizontal overhead light-table research photograph of a familiar steel coffee spoon and its corresponding translucent graphite study. A continuous clean opal-white diffuser fills the canvas; physical construction, clear visual hierarchy and paper transmission are the visible goals.

content_scope.basis: This text-authored field example selects the spoon and its own contour and surface studies within the default subject-study scope.

decisions.subject_basis: One familiar unbranded stainless-steel demitasse coffee spoon, approximately 120 mm long: a conventional shallow oval bowl, smooth continuous rounded rim, a naturally tapered narrow neck and one slim straight handle ending in a softly rounded tip. The bowl is visibly hollow and faces upward. The handle is gently curved in elevation while its plan-view centerline remains straight. The spoon is one continuous formed metal utensil with a polished bowl and a subtly satin-finished handle, a consistent thin rim and ordinary usable proportions.

scene.carrier: Exactly three study pieces: one complete stainless-steel coffee spoon, one large thin tracing-paper sheet with a precise graphite spoon drawing, and one smaller rectangular tracing-paper overlay.
scene.intent: A transmitted-light study of a real coffee spoon and its graphite contour on complete overlapping tracing papers
scene.support: The listed objects have the ordinary material thickness and stable contacts of their recognizable product type. design.composition: Compose a complete 16:9 horizontal overhead still life. The full spoon lies on a gentle diagonal in the left third. One full tracing sheet on the right carries its complete corresponding graphite outline. One smaller translucent rectangle lies wholly within that sheet and crosses the actual graphite neck and handle. The real metal subject is visually dominant through its reflective contrast; all three complete pieces have generous continuous opal-tabletop margins. The optical axis is perpendicular to the tabletop and the sensor is parallel to it. Both sheets are complete physical rectangles with four right-angle corners and parallel opposite edges; place their top and bottom edges horizontally, with all corners inside the canvas.
design.materials: The spoon is credible formed stainless steel: a smooth shallow hollow bowl with a continuous thin rounded rim, a gradual neck transition and a slim satin handle. A broad neutral reflection sweeps through the concave bowl and a darker neighboring reflection makes its depth legible; the fine brushed handle keeps subtle directional texture. Two tracing-paper sheets have delicate fibers, clean thin edges and geometric graphite drawings. The upper sheet attenuates and softens lower graphite only within the actual overlap. The milky-white diffusing tabletop stays clean and smooth, with short soft shadows at the actual spoon and paper contact points. The horizontal softbox light-table has a smooth opal-white diffusing top lit evenly from within. Its exposed surface has a slightly cool neutral luminous value, each single tracing-paper layer slightly attenuates the transmitted light, and the overlapping region has a clearly legible gentle step in optical density. Keep broad diffuse light, realistic exposure, local contact shading and graphite detail simultaneously visible.
design.palette: A controlled neutral palette: luminous milky-white tabletop with a restrained cool-neutral cast, pale translucent paper, graphite and the stated authentic product colors. Reflection brightness and material density set a clear primary and secondary hierarchy. Color accents, when specified, stay on their stated materials.

photography.visible_result: A recognizable real steel coffee spoon with readable dark reflections, a corresponding graphite contour and distinct single-versus-overlapped paper transmission on a luminous milky, slightly cool tabletop; every object and rectangular paper edge is inside the composition.
